request.text: Seamless extremely gentle low bowed-glass resonance on A2 and E3, floating in thick quiet water. Slow breathing and fine silky aqueous grain. Peaceful alert concentration, tender and protective, never frightening. No beat, ticking, riser, crescendo or sub-bass. Stable suspended harmony, no melody or ending. No voices, harsh transients or distortion. Quiet microscopic pond-game sound design.
